title: Chaos Engineering: Building Resilience, Not Just Features
description: Learn why breaking things on purpose with Chaos Engineering makes your production systems stronger, faster, and more reliable.
linkedinHook: Imagine waking up to a critical incident that could have been prevented if you'd just broken something on purpose. That's the power of Chaos Engineering.
linkedinBody: This post unpacks why intentionally injecting faults into your systems isn't just a good idea, it's essential for building truly resilient services. We'll look at how tools like Litmus and Chaos Mesh help, and what senior engineers need to know to avoid common pitfalls.
